A Hidden Gem in the Heart of HCMC
Sep 2026 • Friends
The warm lighting, stylish interior, and soft background music instantly create a cozy yet sophisticated vibe that makes you want to linger for hours.
Located right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City, it’s the perfect sanctuary from the bustling streets outside. Up on the second floor, you'll find a comfortably cooled and well-ventilated space, complete with a lovely terrace that offers a nice view of the city. The food is simply incredible—every dish is thoughtfully crafted, packed with rich flavors, and presented beautifully. To top it all off, the service is world-class; the staff is attentive, welcoming, and genuinely cares about making your dining experience memorable.
An absolute must-visit spot in Saigon for an unforgettable evening!

I ordered the beef shank bún bò, but when the dish arrived, it was mostly blood pudding, with barely any beef shank. The broth also didn’t taste like traditional bún bò to me; it had a flavor and aroma that reminded me more of sour soup.

Unfortunately, the dish did not meet my expectations. I hope the restaurant can improve the ingredients and broth to make the dish more authentic and enjoyable.

Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.

Regarding the ingredients in your bún bò, our standard serving is prepared with a specific proportion of both beef shank and blood pudding. However, we understand that everyone has different preferences. For future visits, please feel free to let our staff know your preferences when ordering. We are always happy to customize the dish to your liking, such as removing any ingredients you do not enjoy.

As for the broth, we understand that taste is very subjective, and we are sorry that our flavor profile did not suit your personal palate on this occasion. We always strive to maintain our traditional recipe, and we truly value your honest input. Please be assured that we have shared your comments directly with our Head Chef to review the dish and ensure our quality standards are consistently maintained.

Thank you once again for your constructive feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a dining experience that better suits your taste.
